name: Collateral Parties 11
definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties of counterparty of Party A.

ClientPartyB.name: Client Party B
ClientPartyB.definition: Party that instructs party B to settle the instruction on its behalf.

CollateralAccount.name: Collateral Account
CollateralAccount.definition: Account where the collateral is held during the lifecycle  of the transaction.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rul.definition: If CollateralAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rul.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, CollateralAccount must be absent.
